Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 Get to know the team
 The Developer Platform team at Auth0 (an Okta company) owns the platform that developers build identity on. Increasingly they build alongside AI agents, and that raises the bar on everything underneath: interfaces have to hold up whether a person or an agent is calling them, and the systems behind them have to stay reliable and coherent as usage grows. We move fast, we own problems end to end, and we care deeply about the platform we put in front of the developers and agents who depend on it.
 The opportunity
 We're hiring a Principal Engineer (P5) to serve as the technical leader and compass for the Developer Platform team. You'll work across the breadth of the platform, tackling the highly complex, vaguely specified problems that span it and turning them into clear technical direction the team can execute against, without day-to-day oversight. Above all, you'll own how the platform is architected to scale: the distributed systems behind it, the reliability and consistency guarantees developers depend on, and the coherence that keeps it easy to build on as usage grows. You'll champion the team's technical execution, raise the engineering bar, mentor the people around you, and partner with tech leads across teams to keep the wider platform aligned. You'll have real influence over how our platform holds up in a world where developers and agents are both first-class consumers.
 What you'll be doing
 Own the platform architecture: Set the technical direction for the developer platform, and make the cross-cutting decisions that keep it coherent and easy to build on as it grows.
 Architect for scale: Design the distributed systems behind the platform for throughput, reliability, and consistency, so the guarantees developers depend on hold up under real load.
 Turn ambiguity into direction: Take the hardest, most vaguely specified platform problems and turn them into clear, modular technical designs the team can execute against.
 Design for developers and agents: Shape the platform so it holds up whether a person or an agent is calling it, and so both can build and automate their work against Auth0.
 Raise the engineering bar: Set the standard for how the team designs, builds, and operates the platform, and lead deep, constructive reviews that grow the engineers around you.
 Partner across teams: Operate peer-to-peer with tech leads in adjacent groups to review major architectural decisions and keep the wider platform aligned.
 What you'll bring
 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record as a Principal or Staff level individual contributor.
 Distributed architecture depth: Extensive experience designing and operating high-scale, reliable backend and event-driven systems, with a strong grasp of the tradeoffs in throughput, consistency, and failure handling.
 Platform thinking: A track record of designing and shipping platforms or developer-facing systems at scale, with an instinct for the interfaces and abstractions that keep them coherent as they grow.
 IAM platform thinking: Deep understanding of identity and access management, with a sense for the platform capabilities and abstractions that make identity easier for developers to build on.
 Ownership in ambiguity: You can own vaguely specified problems and drive them to a clear technical direction without heavy top-down scoping.
 Strong engineering fundamentals: Strong Node.js fundamentals; Go a plus.
 Agent-aware design: Hands-on familiarity with agentic tooling, MCP, or LLM-facing design, and a sense for how agents consume a platform.
 Cross-functional collaboration: Experience working across engineering, product, and architecture in a fast-moving environment, and a habit of raising the bar for the people around you.
 Extra credit
 Work with agent frameworks, AI-facing systems, or developer toolchains in the LLM space.
 A background at a company where developers are the primary customer.
 Experience setting technical direction for a platform that other engineering teams build on.

ABOUT MEMBEE:

Membee is the all-in-one membership management platform for associations, chambers of commerce, nonprofits and clubs. It automates renewals, events, payments and communications so small teams, often volunteer-led, can spend their time attracting, engaging and retaining members instead of administrating them. Our line is simple: grow your organization, don't administrate it.

Our customers are lean teams, often one to three people. They tell us that the hands-on setup, training and support we give them is what they value most, so the people in this role matter a great deal to how customers experience Membee.




THE ROLE:

You will be the voice of Membee for our customers, and the person who makes support better every month. We are using AI to answer more questions faster and to cut the number of tickets customers need to send. That frees our support team to spend less time on repeat questions and more time on the problems that need a person.

You will own support and support operations: live chat and tickets, help content, in-product help, and the AI that supports them. You will report to our General Manager, Care, and work every day with our small engineering team and with product.

This role is for someone sharp, earlier in their career, who wants to see how an AI-enabled SaaS business runs and wants a real hand in shaping it.

This is a one-year contract covering a parental leave, with possible extension into a full-time role.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Answer live chats and support tickets quickly and thoroughly, across membership, events, finance, CRM and website tools. Pick up the phone when a call will solve it faster.

 - Write and update help content so customers can find answers themselves.

 - Build in-product help that answers questions where the customer is working.

 - Improve our AI support agent, Buzz. Review its answers, find the gaps, and feed fixes back so more tickets are closed by AI chat.

 - Cut overall ticket volume. Trace tickets back to their cause and recommend UI/UX changes, better help docs and better AI answers.

 - Test new features and enhancements against a testing plan, then update documentation to match.

 - Act as the customer's advocate. Document recurring usability patterns in detail so product and engineering can act on them.

 - Pass churn risks and upsell signals to Customer Success.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

Required:

 - 2+ years of customer support experience at an SMB or enterprise SaaS company.

 - Clear, structured writing. You can explain a complex idea in a help article or an internal report.

 - Strong root-cause thinking. You look for why a customer got stuck, not only how to unstick them.

 - Comfort with AI tools, and curiosity about how to make them work better for customers.

We also look for:

 - A quick study who picks up new tools and products on the fly, and is happy to switch between tasks.

 - A warm communicator who treats a one-person office or a volunteer board with the same care as anyone else.

 - A self-starter who notices problems and proposes fixes without waiting to be asked.

 - Genuine interest in the operational needs of membership-based organizations.

Nice to have: live chat experience, and hands-on experience working in the back end of websites, especially WordPress.




WHAT YOU'LL GET:

 - Hands-on exposure to an AI-enabled SaaS business. You will use AI every day and help improve it, including the agent that answers our customers.

 - A window into product management. What you learn from customers feeds directly into what we build. You will work with our General Manager and our senior engineers on priorities, and see how those decisions get made.

 - Real training. A structured onboarding period to learn the product, and a deeply experienced team who will mentor you.

 - Clear goals and feedback. We agree on goals with you and give you the feedback to grow.

 - A small, quality-of-life-focused team. Remote work, with equipment provided.




HOW WE WORK:

You will be measured on four things: time to resolution, positive engagement score, tickets closed, and overall ticket reduction.

AI is a tool that makes you better at this job. It does not replace you. Our customers value real human connection, and AI gives you more time to give it.


Our Values at Beacon Software

 - Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.

 - Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant.

 - Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected.

 - Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world - compounding growth.

AI does not make hiring decisions: Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans.  Joignez-vous à l’équipe d’EDC !

 Poste : Associée ou associé / associée principale ou associé principal, Financement structuré et de projets
 Selon les qualifications et l’expérience de la personne retenue, celle-ci pourrait être nommée au niveau d’associé(e) ou d’associé(e) principal(e). 
 Type d’emploi : Affectation permanente
 Rémunération 
 Les salaires sont fondés sur les qualifications et l’expérience et varient généralement comme suit :
 Poste d’associé(e) (Souscriptrice ou souscripteur 16): De 74 297 $ à 99 063 $, plus une rémunération au rendement.
 Poste d’associé(e) (Souscriptrice ou souscripteur 17): De 84 698 $ à 112 931 $, plus une rémunération au rendement.
 Poste d’associé(e) principal(e) (Souscriptrice ou souscripteur 18) : De 96 557 $ à 128 743 $, plus une rémunération au rendement.
 Lieu de travail 
 Exportation et développement Canada (EDC) offre un environnement de travail hybride où les employés sont actuellement tenus de travailler au bureau trois jours par semaine (sous réserve de modifications). 
 Associé(e): ce poste sera exercé au siège social d’EDC à Ottawa.
 Associé principal : Ce poste devrait être exercé à Ottawa. Toutefois, les candidatures de personnes établies à Toronto ou à Montréal pourront également être prises en considération.
 Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats et candidates admissibles. 
 À propos d’EDC
 À Exportation et développement Canada (EDC), nous aidons les entreprises canadiennes à réussir à l’étranger. En tant que société d’État à vocation financière, EDC propose des solutions financières innovantes et des conseils d’experts pour aider les entreprises à explorer de nouveaux marchés, à atténuer leurs risques et à se développer.
 Pourquoi vous joindre à EDC? 
 Gamme complète d’avantages sociaux : EDC offre un régime de rémunération et d’avantages sociaux concurrentiel, une bonne conciliation travail-vie personnelle et la chance de contribuer à bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce.
 Conciliation travail-vie personnelle : EDC offre un régime concurrentiel en ce qui concerne la rémunération et la conciliation travail-vie personnelle : différentes options de travail hybride, trois à quatre semaines de vacances, une période de fermeture, des vendredis d’été raccourcis et les vendredis sans réunion.
 Perfectionnement professionnel : Profitez de nos occasions d’apprentissage continu, notamment des programmes de formation, des ateliers et de la formation linguistique.
 Culture inclusive : Intégrez un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif qui lutte pour l’équité en matière d’emploi et valorise la diversité des idées, des forces et des origines pour favoriser la réussite.
 Programmes de bien-être : Nous offrons des initiatives de bien-être, de l’aide à la santé mentale et des programmes de conditionnement physique pour veiller à votre santé et à votre bonheur.
 Investissement dans la collectivité : Participez à des activités de bénévolat et donnez au suivant grâce à un éventail de programmes de responsabilité sociale. 
 Aperçu de l’équipe
 L’Équipe du financement structuré et de projets d’EDC est un chef de file dans le financement de projets et d’infrastructures à l’échelle mondiale. Elle joue un rôle important dans la croissance du Canada, la diversification de son commerce international et le développement d’infrastructures facilitant le commerce au Canada. Depuis sa création en 1995, l’Équipe a conclu plus de 700 transactions financières dans le monde entier, totalisant plus de 60 milliards de dollars américains. Elle fournit également du leadership éclairé aux parties prenantes internes et gouvernementales sur d’importants projets liés aux minéraux critiques, la transition énergétique et aux infrastructures facilitant le commerce.
 Le financement de projets est un domaine spécialisé de la finance, dans lequel les décisions de financement reposent sur les flux de trésorerie et les actifs propres à des projets. Il est largement utilisé dans les secteurs de l’énergie, des énergies renouvelables, de l’exploitation minière et des minéraux critiques, des infrastructures de transport ainsi que des infrastructures numériques, entre autres. Les contreparties de l’Équipe du financement structuré et de projets d’EDC comprennent des promoteurs internationaux de premier rang, des exportateurs, des cabinets d’avocats ainsi que des banques de financement de projets et d’investissement internationales.
 Programme des associés en financement de projets (PAFP) :
 Les postes d’associé(e) et d’associé(e) principal(e) offrent la possibilité de développer et de mettre en pratique une expertise en financement de projets grâce à une participation concrète à la modélisation financière et aux analyses de sensibilité, à la structuration du crédit, au contrôle préalable, à la documentation juridique ainsi qu’aux interactions avec les clients, les promoteurs, les conseillers et les cobailleurs de fonds.
 Les associés participeront au Programme des associés en financement de projets (PAFP) d’EDC, qui combine apprentissage structuré, mentorat de membres chevronnés de l’équipe, rétroaction régulière et expérience pratique dans le cadre de transactions liées à des projets à fortes retombées. Le programme permet de développer des compétences en financement de projets dans des domaines comme la modélisation financière et les analyses de sensibilité, la structuration du crédit, le contrôle préalable, la documentation juridique et les interactions avec les clients, les promoteurs, les conseillers et les cobailleurs de fonds.
 La participation au programme sera adaptée au rôle, à l’expérience et aux besoins de perfectionnement de chaque personne. 
 Ce que vous ferez
 Recherche, analyse financière et modélisation : 
 Effectuer des recherches sectorielles et sur les marchés dans les secteurs ou régions pertinents
 Effectuer des analyses financières; utiliser et élaborer des modèles de flux de trésorerie détaillés.
 Évaluer les hypothèses des modèles au moyen de recherches sur les secteurs et d’analyses comparatives de projets similaires.
 Exécution de transactions 
 Soutenir le contrôle préalable et l’analyse de transactions complexes de prêts de financement dans le cadre de projets en tant que membre d’une équipe responsable des transactions.
 Préparer des composantes de la trousse de crédit à des fins d’approbation interne.
 Participer à la négociation de documents liés aux transactions avec le conseiller juridique et les contreparties.
 Engagement des clients et gestion de portefeuille 
 Communiquer professionnellement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes pendant l’exécution des transactions.
 Suivre l’évolution des marchés et les occasions, contribuer à l’élaboration de propositions de financement et mener des exercices d’analyse du marché afin d’en dégager les tendances et les principaux constats.
 Contribuer à la gestion du portefeuille pendant toute la durée des transactions.
 Compétences et aptitudes
 Compétences techniques :
 Maîtrise de la modélisation financière et des applications de feuilles de calcul.
 Capacité à trouver et à traiter les données provenant de Bloomberg et de Capital IQ.
 Connaissance des marchés du crédit ainsi que des marchés des capitaux.
 Connaissances commerciales et du secteur: 
 Compréhension des secteurs de l’énergie, des énergies renouvelables, de l’exploitation minière et des minéraux critiques, des infrastructures de transport ou des infrastructures numériques.
 Connaissance des pratiques commerciales et bancaires canadiennes ou internationales.
 Entregent: 
 Solide esprit d’équipe et qualités de leadership.
 Excellentes compétences en communication orale, en communication écrite et en présentations.
 Solides capacités de négociation, de diplomatie et de persuasion.
 Ce que nous recherchons 
 Maîtrise en administration des affaires (MBA), ou maîtrise avec une spécialisation en finance, en commerce international ou dans un domaine connexe, ou combinaison équivalente d’études et d’expérience professionnelle pertinente
 Minimum de 2 ans (Associé, Souscripteur 16), de 5 ans (Associé, Souscripteur 17) ou de 7 ans (Associé principal, Souscripteur 18) d’expérience pertinente, notamment une expérience directe dans la réalisation d’opérations de financement de projets, ou une expérience étroitement comparable en financement structuré ou en services bancaires d’investissement.
 L’expérience pertinente peut avoir été acquise en financement de projets, en services bancaires d’investissement ou dans un rôle financier au sein d’un secteur à forte intensité de capital se prêtant au financement de projets, comme l’énergie, les énergies renouvelables, l’exploitation minière et les minéraux critiques, les infrastructures de transport ou les infrastructures numériques. Les personnes candidates devraient démontrer une expérience en modélisation financière, en analyse de crédit, en structuration de transactions, en contrôle préalable et en documentation juridique.
 Ce qui vous distinguera 
 Expérience dans l’avancement de volets de transactions de financement de projets, l’analyse de modèles financiers complexes, la préparation de recommandations de crédit ou les interactions directes avec des promoteurs, prêteurs et conseillers

 Carrier is seeking a highly skilled Project Manager to oversee our scope of work in data center construction projects. This role is responsible for the startup, commissioning, and field modifications of Carrier air- and water-cooled chillers. The Project Manager will work closely with internal and external teams including engineering, factory operations, field service, commissioning authorities, general contractors, and subcontractors.  
 The primary job sites are located in the Alberta Canada providence . Please note that extensive travel for onsite construction project management outside this geography may be required.  
 This is a Fixed Term position that is 18-24 Months. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
  Project Execution & Management  
 Lead startup, commissioning, and field modification processes for Carrier air- and water-cooled chillers in newly constructed data centers.  
 Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, ensuring schedules and budgets are met.  
 Track and review key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor project success.  
 Conduct progress meetings with stakeholders, addressing design, material delivery, and labor schedules.  
 Ensure all projects meet or exceed booked profit margin goals.  
 Work with project coordination to order and track all chiller parts needed for warranty execution.  
 Stakeholder & Customer Coordination  
 Collaborate with sales, prime contractors, and end-users to fulfill project scope and deliverables.  
 Serve as the primary liaison representing Carrier between the customer, commissioning authority, general contractor, and subcontractors, ensuring smooth communication and project progression.  
 Provide professional, timely resolution for customer concerns, ensuring satisfaction with all aspects of project execution.  
 Technical Expertise & Compliance  
 Interpret and apply mechanical, electrical, and architectural drawings to ensure compliance with design specifications.  
 Ensure adherence to industry codes, standards, and project specifications.  
 Apply working knowledge of Building Automation System (BAS) integration to ensure proper controls functionality.  
 Manage the change order process, preventing scope creep and maintaining project integrity.  
 Financial & Operational Oversight  
 Accurately forecast monthly revenue by estimating project completion costs.  
 Manage project documentation, including warranty processing and factory-generated service information in collaboration with our Service Engineering team.  
 Maintain rigorous job safety standards across all projects.  
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS  
 High school diploma or GED.  
 5+ years of experience in project management coordinating project schedules, deliverables, and activities involving multiple stakeholders, contractors, vendors, and/or customers; OR  4+ years of experience supporting mechanical, electrical, controls, commissioning, construction, or field service projects. 
 2+ years reading and interpreting blueprints and technical mechanical systems documents.  
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS  
 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering; or a Master's degree/MBA.  
 Data center industry experience with water- or air-cooled chillers.  
 Commercial HVAC expertise, including centrifugal chillers, Cooling Distribution Unit systems, and airside equipment.  
 Projection Management Professional certification.  
 Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design certification or experience with Building Automation Systems  
 Strong ability to multi-task, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

 Proven strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.  
 Strong ability to build rapport and trust with customers through active listening and effective solutions.

 Job ID #32293: Network Analyst I - Datacentre Operations 
 Union: Non Union
 Job Description ID #: 2203 
 Close date: Interested applicants please submit your application online at www.hamilton.ca/city-council/jobs-city by 4:00 p.m. on November 4, 2026.  
 Duration:  Up to 18 months
 Vacancy type: This posting is for an existing vacancy  
 Internal applicants should apply with your work e-mail address . External applicants are considered only after the internal posting process has been completed. Only applicants chosen for an interview will be contacted.
 SUMMARY OF DUTIES 
 Reporting to the Supervisor, Datacentre Operations the Network Analyst I designs, installs, troubleshoots, maintains, repairs and upgrades server infrastructure and storage systems and related virtualization, backup and recovery platforms to meet the functional objectives of the business. This includes provisioning of both physical and virtual environments and supporting approved cloud environments for development and production applications, email and collaboration services and disaster recovery across the City’s divisions. This role is primarily focused on projects and project-related activities but also provides day-to-day operational support as required.
 The Network Analyst I configures and troubleshoots server hardware/software and maintains the City’s messaging environment. This individual maintains datacentre operations by working with facility and hardware/software vendors and applicable cloud service providers to ensure timely problem resolution and reliable service delivery. The incumbent maintains and utilizes operations management applications to identify faults, ensure the provision of data or other datacentre services to customers, and the reliable storage, protection and recovery of data.
 The position completes assigned incidents, service requests, operational work and project deliverables, maintains supporting documentation and escalates matters outside its authority or technical scope.
 GENERAL DUTIES 
 Develops, configures, installs and troubleshoots datacentre systems including servers, SAN and backup & recovery systems, to meet the functional objectives of the business, including performing system upgrades in accordance with approved designs, technical standards and change controls.
 Implements and maintains approved infrastructure configurations and technical baselines. Identifies configuration drift, unsupported components and deviations from approved requirements and completes or escalates corrective action through established change-management processes.
 Monitors and supports datacentre power infrastructure, including uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), generators and power distribution units (PDUs), in coordination with Facilities and qualified service providers to maintain continuous power to datacentre equipment. Supports power-capacity planning, scheduled maintenance and failover testing, and escalates faults or risks affecting service continuity.
 Provides second and third level support to the user community for infrastructure related issues on referral from the service desk and in support of Service Desk staff and other authorized IT partners.
 Reviews issues, assigned incidents, service requests and problem logs relating to datacentre operations, initiates and follows through with resolution or appropriate escalation, and records actions, findings and outcomes in the City’s service-management system. Maintains communications with IT and business leaders and relevant service providers on datacentre availability and outages.
 Contributes to problem management and post-incident reviews by investigating recurring issues, identifying underlying causes and completing assigned corrective or preventive actions.
 Maintains, monitors and updates email and virtualization applications including Exchange, VMware and Citrix, and related messaging, collaboration and infrastructure platforms within the assigned scope.
 Provides input to plans and designs of the datacentre architecture and infrastructure, including modernization, lifecycle renewal, resilience and approved hybrid-cloud initiatives.
 Performs capacity and resource planning, assesses server and storage risks and supports contingency planning in collaboration with the Supervisor, Network Services and Technology Architect and other relevant technical teams.
 Tests server/SAN performance and provides performance statistics and reports; analyzes results and makes recommendations for maintaining and improving the availability, performance, capacity and reliability of datacentre infrastructure.
 Uses approved monitoring and alerting tools to identify service degradation, capacity constraints and infrastructure faults and coordinates or completes assigned corrective action.
 Researches, analyses, tests and implements approved software patches firmware updates and/or hardware changes to fix identified deficiencies as directed, documenting implementation results and following established change, testing and rollback procedures.
 Maintains authorized users, issues user IDs, manages password protection, and sets up file, application and printer permissions for authorized users, within the assigned scope and in accordance with approved access requests and least-privilege requirements.
 Uses privileged access only for authorized purposes and supports the secure management of infrastructure service accounts, credentials, certificates and keys within the assigned scope.
 Develops and maintains technical and operational documentation and provides on-the-job training and coaching to IT staff on technologies and systems, including operating procedures, configuration records, support instructions and recovery processes.
 Participates in the evaluation of new products and services, may manage vendor service level agreements within delegated authority, monitoring deliverables and escalating service, performance or contractual concerns.
 Procures datacentre infrastructure components in accordance with purchasing and departmental policies and procedures and delegated purchasing authority. Selects, develops, integrates and implements approved datacentre management applications.
 In collaboration with the Security and Technology staff, reviews server security and implements, configures, maintains and monitors the datacentre environment in accordance with approved security baselines, access controls and configuration standards.
 Identifies and remediates assigned infrastructure vulnerabilities, insecure configurations and unsupported components in accordance with approved priorities and timelines. Documents validation results, outstanding risks and required escalation.
 Maintains required infrastructure logging and supports Security staff with technical evidence and assigned containment, restoration and remediation activities during incidents.
 Evaluates and makes recommendations to IT Management on new technologies, equipment, processes and standards for datacentre infrastructure hardware and software in relation to assessed business needs.
 Identifies opportunities to simplify and standardize recurring infrastructure work through scripting, orchestration and other repeatable, technology-enabled practices. Tests, documents and maintains approved solutions using appropriate version control, review and change-management procedures.
 May be assigned to an initiative or project requiring the individual to take direction from another IT Unit Manager and/or Project Manager. Completes assigned planning, design input, configuration, implementation, testing, documentation and operational handover activities in accordance with approved scope, priorities and timelines.
 Installs, tests and maintains datacentre management software. Implements, maintains and tests approved backup, restoration, replication and disaster-recovery capabilities. Documents recovery results, dependencies, deficiencies and corrective actions against established recovery requirements.
 Maintains accurate infrastructure asset, configuration and lifecycle records. Supports the transition of new or changed systems into operation by confirming documentation, monitoring, access, support, backup, recovery and escalation arrangements.
 Delivers infrastructure projects, implementation activities, operational support and assigned work in accordance with approved priorities, service demand, risk and available team capacity. Work assignments may change in response to project requirements, incidents, service disruptions, technology changes and organizational needs.
 Supports related datacentre and infrastructure functions, including design input, installation, upgrades, troubleshooting, recovery and operational handover, where operational requirements and the incumbent’s demonstrated knowledge and capability permit. May be assigned to initiatives or projects under the direction of an IT Unit Manager or Project Manager.
 Works in accordance with applicable health and safety legislation and all City of Hamilton corporate and departmental occupational health and safety policies and procedures. Uses required equipment, materials and safe-work procedures and promptly reports hazards, incidents and unsafe conditions through the appropriate channels.
 The duties are not exhaustive and may evolve based on operational needs, organizational priorities, emerging risks and technological changes. The incumbent may perform other related duties and assigned work consistent with the position.
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 University Degree or College Diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Technology or related discipline
 Two (2) to five (5) years experience in infrastructure/network environments in administration and support.
 Experience administering Windows Server environments with working knowledge of Linux.
 Experience configuring, installing and maintaining server hardware, SAN/storage systems, and physical and virtual server environments.
 Working knowledge of datacentre operations, including virtualization (VMware, Citrix), backup & recovery technologies, and datacentre power infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators and PDU distribution.
 Experience supporting messaging and collaboration technologies, including Microsoft Exchange, SMTP, and related services.
 Demonstrated analytical, troubleshooting, planning, and problem-resolution skills, including the investigation and resolution of complex infrastructure issues.
 Working knowledge of networking systems and identity services including DNS, DHCP and Active Directory, protocols, and standards such as Ethernet, LAN, WAN, VoIP, TCP/IP, wireless networking and fibre optics, switches, routers & wireless controllers using Cisco IOS.
 Working knowledge of enterprise security technologies and practices, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, endpoint protection, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration, and least-privilege principles.
 Knowledge of project implementation methodologies, ITIL service management practices, change management, documentation, operational handover, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
 Experience supporting database technologies (Oracle and SQL Server), infrastructure monitoring, logging, alerting, backup restoration, disaster recovery testing, and service restoration activities.
 Strong leadership, communication, customer service, and teamwork skills, with the ability to prepare technical documentation, reports, and recommendations. Relevant Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, Linux, storage, backup, recovery, cloud, or infrastructure certifications and experience with scripting or automation tools are considered assets.
 Must possess and maintain a valid Class G Drivers’ Licence in the Province of Ontario.
 THIS POSITION REQUIRES A VALID CLASS "G" DRIVER'S LICENCE AND PROOF THEREOF IS REQUIRED AFTER HIRE.

 Hybrid work arrangement with approximately 50% on-site attendance, typically two (2) days one week and three (3) days the following week, subject to operational requirements. Should this job requirement change, parking will only be provided in accordance with the City policy in force at that time.

Efficiency Addict: You know that little rush you get when you replace a 15-step manual process with one automated workflow? Or when you finally figure out why Salesforce isn't behaving? Or when you connect two systems that should have been talking to each other all along? 
 If that feeling never gets old AND and you're looking for a place where you can make that kind of impact, then keep reading!
 AlgaeCal is on the hunt for an IT Administrator who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and keep our tech systems running smoothly.
 Small print here ⇒ We need someone with experience in IT management and a passion for problem-solving. So if you don’t love tech like Steve Jobs loved turtlenecks, you might want to stop here.
 Still here? Great…
 This job will give you ALL the feels: 
 At AlgaeCal, we’re driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density. 
 The good news? AlgaeCal has the world’s only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal. 
 Here’s what you’ll be up to in this busy role: 
 Slack, Jira & Confluence: You’ll build and support workflows and automations across the tools our teams use every day. If there’s a repetitive process that can be streamlined, you’ll probably be the person who figures out how.
 Google Workspace: You’ll own the day-to-day administration of Google Workspace. From user accounts and permissions to troubleshooting issues and keeping everything secure and running smoothly.
 Security & Compliance: You’ll help protect AlgaeCal by supporting security training, risk assessments, compliance controls, and internal and external audits across frameworks like SOC 2, PCI, and HIPAA.
 Hardware & Software: You’ll be the go-to person when technology decides not to cooperate. Computers, routers, A/V equipment, software, inventory—you’ll troubleshoot problems, keep everything organized, and make sure our team has the tools they need to get their work done.
 Salesforce: You’ll help keep our Salesforce ecosystem humming. Supporting requests from internal teams, troubleshooting and improving flows, and spotting opportunities to make the system cleaner, smarter, and easier to use.
 ERP Systems: You’ll play a hands-on role in implementing and improving our ERP system. That means helping design workflows, building automations, troubleshooting issues, and making sure the system actually makes people’s jobs easier.

Additionally, this role acts as the functional owner of the group’s financial technology, participating in the implementation of an electronic data warehouse for unified financial and statistical reporting, while establishing robust access management protocols for key financial systems.
 This is a hands-on leadership role. You will operate at both strategic and execution levels, ensuring audit readiness, controlled working capital, and consistent margin reporting across agencies.
 Core Mandate 
 Deliver consolidated financial statements within the established group close calendar, with a business day five target as entity close processes mature
 Provide expertise on technical accounting matters
 Oversee global group taxation and manage the relationship with the group’s external advisors
 Responsibility for administration of core financial systems
 Mentor a growing team of accountants in an indirect relationship
 Key Responsibilities 
 Financial Reporting & Consolidations 
 Manage the month-end, quarter-end, and annual financial consolidation for 10-15 corporate entities.
 Oversee multi-currency consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and translation adjustments between CAD and USD.
 Prepare accurate, timely consolidated financial statements, management reports, and variance analyses for senior leadership and the Board of Directors.
 Serve as the primary contact for external auditors, managing the annual audit process and supporting audit readiness and the timely resolution of findings and control deficiencies.
 Financial Data Warehouse 
 Participate in designing, implementing, and maintaining an electronic data warehouse (EDW) to centralize financial, operational, and statistical data.
 Define finance requirements for standardized data collection, mapping pipelines, and extraction methodologies across all entities to ensure a "single source of truth."
 Partner with IT and operations teams to translate complex accounting structures into robust relational data models and automated reporting dashboards.
 Ensure the data warehouse supports historical archiving, multi-period audit readiness, and quick data retrieval for M&A due diligence.
 Financial Systems & Access Management 
 Serve as the primary business owner for the group's key financial systems and ERP platform.
 Design, implement, and manage a user access management framework, ensuring strict Segregation of Duties (SoD) across all entities, in partnership with IT and system administrators.
 Periodically review system access permissions to comply with internal controls, corporate governance, and data privacy regulations.
 Group Taxation (Canada & US) 
 Oversee cross-border tax compliance, including corporate income tax filings, GST/HST, PST, and QST in Canada, and federal, state, and local tax filings in the US, coordinating filings with internal teams and external advisors.

 Manage indirect tax reporting and ensure compliance with multi-state and multi-provincial tax regulations.
 Technical Accounting & Policies 
 Research, interpret, and implement new accounting standards under applicable accounting standards.
 Develop, document, and maintain comprehensive corporate accounting policies and internal control procedures across all group entities.
 Provide technical accounting guidance on complex transactions, including business combinations, asset acquisitions, and revenue recognition.

 7-10 years progressive accounting experience

Aviso Wealth: 
 At Aviso, we are dedicated to improving the financial well-being of Canadians. As a leading wealth management organization, we are committed to leadership, innovation, partnership, responsibility, and community. Working with talented and energetic professionals who exemplify our values every day, you will quickly notice that our people and dynamic ‘oneaviso’ culture sets us apart. If you are looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, find out more about what Aviso has to offer at www.aviso.ca .
 The Opportunity: 
 We are looking to fill an opening for a Senior Product Manager to join Aviso’s Product Management team and help shape the future of investing for Canadians through a best-in-class wealth advisor platform. 
 Reporting to the Director of Product Management, the Senior Product Manager will lead the Advisor Hub product family and directly own Advisor Hub ACP, which serves advisors at ACP introducing brokers and portfolio management firms. You will also manage and coach three Product Owners who own the other products in the family.
 You will help establish and champion our customer-centric product model: empowered, cross-functional teams that discover meaningful customer and business problems, test solutions early, and deliver value incrementally. Working in a leadership triad with a Product Designer and Tech Lead, you are accountable for product value and business viability; the Product Designer leads on desirability and usability; and the Tech Lead and engineers lead on technical feasibility. Together, you share responsibility for product outcomes and make informed trade-offs rather than treating feature delivery as the goal.
 This is both a hands-on product role and a people leadership role. You will bring a deep understanding of customers, product data and business constraints to the area you own, working with your team to discover solutions that deliver measurable outcomes. Across the product family, you will set direction, guide priorities and coach Product Owners to lead their areas as outcome-oriented product leaders rather than backlog administrators. You will also champion this way of working across Aviso, building trust through evidence, collaboration and incremental results as we continue to adopt the customer-centric product model.
 As one aviso: 
 We Care – You do the right thing for clients, partners and colleagues. You build trusted relationships, champion service excellence, and contribute to a culture where people feel valued and supported
 We Dare –You challenge the status quo with bold ideas and fresh perspectives. You embrace change, seek opportunities to innovate and are comfortable exploring new ways of working
 We Share – You collaborate openly and build meaningful relationships. You seek out diverse perspectives, share your knowledge and work together to help colleagues, clients and partners succeed
 We Deliver – You take ownership of your work, honour your commitments and focus on delivering meaningful results. You hold yourself accountable and continuously look for ways to improve
 What your day looks like: 
 Set product direction and measurable outcomes for the product family with the Director of Product Management; align the areas owned by your Product Owners with customer needs and Aviso’s business priorities
 Lead discovery in your own area and coach Product Owners to work with customers, users, data and stakeholders to understand problems, test assumptions, and evaluate opportunities before committing to solutions
 Partner with the Product Designer and Tech Lead in the leadership triad to explore options and balance value, viability, desirability and feasibility; involve engineers early and make trade-offs together
 Break larger opportunities into small, testable increments; collaborate with the team on a practical release plan, learn from each release, and adapt based on customer behaviour and measurable outcomes rather than feature output alone
 Own prioritization and the product backlog for your area, ensuring stories and other work are clear and ordered for implementation; support your Product Owners in doing the same, without taking ownership of engineering implementation or technical delivery
 Work with partners in compliance, privacy, operations, marketing, finance and technology to understand constraints early, address dependencies and ensure solutions can work for the business
 Manage, coach and develop Product Owners across their product areas, creating clarity on outcomes, strengthening discovery and judgement, and fostering collaborative relationships with design and technology counterparts
 Communicate product direction, evidence, trade-offs and results to stakeholders; advocate for the customer-centric product model, demonstrate its value through incremental wins, and help remove organizational barriers to its adoption
 Stay curious about investor needs, industry trends and the competitive landscape, using those insights to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities for meaningful improvement
 Requirements 
 Your experience and skills: 
 Innovation benefits from diverse perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. We encourage you to apply if you meet most, even if not all, of the following requirements:
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
 Significant hands-on experience managing technology-powered products; typically 8+ years of related experience, though equivalent depth and impact are welcome

 Summary 
 Under general supervision, the Customer and Network Facing Technician is a universal technician that is responsible for performing field installation and service work, troubleshooting, repair and maintenance of cable television, internet, and telephony systems. This role supports the growth of the system by ensuring the quality performance of technical services, installation setup, testing, and maintenance of all current and future products and services over Hybrid Fiber Coax (HFC) and Fiber to the Home (FTTH) networks. The incumbent ensures the quality of services provided to end-users meets or exceeds established industry and company performance standards and complies with FCC requirements and protocol. 
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 
 Install, maintain, disconnect, and troubleshoot television, high-speed internet, telephony, and automation systems for residential and business clients. 
 Performs preventative maintenance and repair of the HFC and FTTH networks, including all associated equipment, in accordance with company engineering standards. 
 Read and accurately interpret system/network design maps. 
 Install and replace HFC physical plant network components such as coax, actives, passives, grounding systems, pedestals, riser guards, conduit, etc., according to technical specifications. 
 Identify and repair upstream and downstream ingress. 
 Complete end-of-line network testing to meet technical specifications. 
 Regularly test all HFC network components using test equipment including: signal level meters, volt-ohm meters, leakage detector, Time Domain Reflectometer (TDR), and Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR). 
 Perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot, and update records of standby power supplies according to technical specifications. 
 Troubleshoot and repair basic distribution problems associated with RF, AC, and DC elements of the forward and reverse plant. 
 Restore system service outages. 
 Perform CLI rideouts and monitor and repair signal leakages. 
 Maintain tools and equipment inventory. 
 Accurately complete work orders in a timely manner. 
 Maintain, secure, and stock assigned vehicle and equipment. 
 Ensure productivity is being tracked through company applications (e.g., NRBY, WFX, Stratusync, iGlass). 
 Work alongside Headend personnel to properly OTDR any damaged fiber. 
 Properly assist on projects such as Remote Phy, 5-85 Mhz, Node activation, E2E testing on new properties, etc. 
 Prepare for daily work assignments by requisitioning equipment and supplies from the warehouse and stocking the vehicle as needed. 
 Maintain company truck and other equipment per service requirements and safety guidelines. 
 Drive a company vehicle between office/home, warehouse, and work sites in a safe and courteous manner, and in accordance with all laws and company policies. 
 Communicate with dispatch (via WFX, phone, etc.) for assistance, status on current installs, or new service requests. 
 Consult with supervisor and other technicians for advice and assistance as needed. 
 Interact with customers in a professional, courteous manner, including when responding to escalations and repeated customer concerns. 
 Educate customers regarding their existing and new services and promote other company services. 
 Comply with all safety procedures and policies. 
 Competencies 
 To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies: 
 Integrity: Tactful, maintains confidence, fosters an ethical work environment, prevents inappropriate behaviors by coworkers. 
 Initiative: Brings about great results from ordinary circumstances; prepares for problems or opportunities in advance; transforms leads or ideas into productive business outcomes; undertakes additional responsibilities and responds to situations as they arise without supervision. 
 Planning, Prioritizing, and Goal Setting: Prepares for emerging customer needs; manages multiple projects; determines project urgency; uses goals to guide actions and creates detailed action plans. 
 Communication: Clearly conveys information through a variety of media (verbal, written, e-mail, v-mail, etc.) in a way that engages the audience and helps them understand and remember the message; listens well. 
 Self-Development and Continuous Learning: Stays informed of current industry trends; actively identifies opportunities for learning; learns and applies new concepts to improve job performance; shares information with others on the job; takes responsibility for career development. 
 Customer Focus: Demonstrates a high level of service delivery; does what is necessary to ensure customer satisfaction; addresses and resolves service failures; prioritizes customer needs; makes customers and their needs a primary focus of actions. 
 Collaboration and Teamwork: Recognizes others’ perspective, objectives and motives; works collaboratively towards solutions that benefit all involved parties and help accomplish common Cogeco objectives. 
 Attention to Detail: Alert in high intensity/high-risk environments; follows detailed procedures and ensures accuracy in documentation and data; carefully monitors gauges, instruments, or processes; concentrates on routine work detail and organizes and maintains a system of records. 
 Adaptability: Works with little supervision; manages ambiguity and autonomy; flexibility to work in an unstructured environment; deals effectively with uncertainty and change.
